# KINX Linear Modules

> KINX is a linear module manufacturer in Dongguan, Guangdong, China. This site is a set of selection guides for ball screw and belt driven linear modules: stroke, load and orientation, speed, accuracy and environment. Models, strokes and datasheets live on the product site: https://hello532.github.io/kinxfa/

Contact: WhatsApp +86 134 1117 7757, email kinxauto@gmail.com

## Selection guides

- [What is a linear module?](https://hello532.github.io/linear-module-guide/guides/what-is-a-linear-module.html): Definition, internals, the drive types, and how a linear module differs from a bare linear guide.
- [Ball screw vs belt driven](https://hello532.github.io/linear-module-guide/guides/ball-screw-vs-belt-driven.html): Which drive suits precision and which suits long stroke and speed, with the axis speed formula (mm/s = rpm / 60 x lead).
- [Sizing for assembly and testing machines](https://hello532.github.io/linear-module-guide/guides/linear-module-for-assembly-machine.html): Five questions that decide the module — stroke, load and orientation, speed, accuracy, environment.
- [Sourcing direct from the factory](https://hello532.github.io/linear-module-guide/guides/linear-module-supplier-southeast-asia.html): What to prepare before contacting a factory, and what to ask back.

## Published facts

- Positioning accuracy ±0.01 mm; repeatability 0.003–0.01 mm.
- KK production models: KK5002; KK6005 / KK6010 / KK6020; KK8610 / KK8620; KK10020 (expected early 2026).
- Effective strokes: KK50 standard strokes 70 / 120 / 170 / 220 mm; KK60 20–810 mm any length in range; KK86 50–1310 mm any length in range.
- Motor adaptation: KK50 servo 50/100 W, stepper 42; KK60 servo 50/100/200/400 W, stepper 42/57/60; KK86 servo 50/100/200/400/750 W, stepper 57/60/86.
- Delivery: proposal in 6 hours; standard KK60/KK86, 50–100 units in 2–3 days with rush orders in 1–2 days; embedded modules GTH5/8 in 3–4 days and GTH12 in 5–6 days; fastest delivery 24 hours.
- Accuracy grades on KK60 and KK86: C and P, figures listed in the sizing guide.
- ISO 9001:2015 certified quality system; patent certificate wall on site; listed central-government procurement supplier.
- Shipped and in service: vision labeling machines and medical equipment. These are completed orders, not target markets.
- Mounting dimensions match THK SKR/KR, PMI KM and MISUMI C-KS series; send your drawing for a fit check before ordering.
